description: CALCULATION. Use this to compare one creator's caller-supplied metrics with the published entry requirements. Returns published_criteria_status of meets_published_criteria, does_not_meet_published_criteria, or unknown, plus pass/fail/unknown per requirement. Do not use it when you need the numeric shortfall (calculate_gap) or the rules without a creator (get_monetization_requirements).

inputSchema.description: CALCULATION tool. Creator metrics in; pass/fail per published entry requirement of the Monetization Program out, plus unknowns and requirements needing the creator's own confirmation. Never returns an 'eligible' verdict: the result is meets_published_criteria / does_not_meet_published_criteria / unknown, with a fixed disclaimer that invitation is at Snap's discretion. Ongoing requirements for enrolled creators are reported separately only when already_enrolled=true. Caller metrics are checked for plausibility. spotlight_view_time_hours_28d above view_time_hours_28d returns VALUE_INCONSISTENT. view_time_hours_28d above 28 days × 24 hours × followers × 0.5 is a warning that the figure is unusually high for your follower count, please check for a typo. The warning also says view time can come from non-followers. followers of 0 with hours above 0 is the same kind of warning, never an error.

already_enrolled.description: Set true only if the creator is already enrolled in the Monetization Program. Default false: only entry (invitation) requirements are evaluated. When true, ongoing requirements for enrolled creators are reported in a separate section.

confirmations.description: Caller's answers to qualitative requirements (requires_user_confirmation rules), keyed by rule id. We record the answer as given and never verify it.

metrics.description: Metrics supplied by the caller (the creator or their agent). We never look metrics up ourselves; Snap offers no public analytics for arbitrary usernames. All fields optional; missing fields produce `unknowns`, never guesses. Data minimization: no age, birthdate, name, or username is accepted; creator age is never stored. Caller metrics are checked for plausibility. spotlight_view_time_hours_28d above view_time_hours_28d returns VALUE_INCONSISTENT. view_time_hours_28d above 28 days × 24 hours × followers × 0.5 is a warning that the figure is unusually high for your follower count, please check for a typo. The warning also says view time can come from non-followers. followers of 0 with hours above 0 is the same kind of warning, never an error.

country.description: Country of residence. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (US), alpha-3 (USA), or the English name on the reviewed country map (United States). Unlisted territories stay unknown.

is_snap_star.description: Self-reported Snap Star status. Cannot be verified by us; treated as a user confirmation.

meets_age_requirement.description: Whether the creator meets the age requirement (18 or the local age of majority). true/false as stated by the caller; null = unknown and returns requires_user_confirmation. Data minimization: we never ask for or store a creator's age or birthdate.

spotlight_view_time_hours_28d.description: Spotlight view time in hours over the last 28 days.

view_time_hours_28d.description: Total view time in hours over the last 28 days, as shown in Snapchat Insights.

metrics_as_of.description: Date the metrics were read from Insights.

program.description: Programs the calculation tools evaluate in v1. Other in-scope programs (payouts, tax, snap_star, creator_monetization_policy, recommendation_eligibility, brand_partnerships) are served as FACTs by get_monetization_requirements; Snap Star status is evaluated as a prerequisite inside unified_monetization_program.
